Clear costs. Owner control. Platform fees are 3.5% on Starter, 2.5% on Growth and 1.5% on Scale, plus Stripe processing. Optional add-ons and usage charges are separate; check plan details before activating.

Business-value snapshots are planning estimates, not appraisals or promises of a sale price or financing. Photo insights require activation and allowance, owner review and live validation. Weather and route recommendations support your decisions; they do not automatically change confirmed appointments.

These real before-and-after photos come from an early customer test. They show the yard work—not a promise of results produced by AI.

  1. Capture. Keep a record of the yard before and after service.
  2. Review. Optional AI insights can flag visible conditions for the operator to check.
  3. Offer. Build an optional service using your approved rates.
  4. Approve. Let the homeowner choose before additional work is agreed.

Photo analysis is an optional feature awaiting live validation. Suggestions are not plant diagnoses or automatic charges.
